description: A heart-failure clinic access coordinator must assign one newly opened next-day evaluation slot between two referrals and document the appropriate visit format and alternate follow-up, with input from a triage nurse and an authorization specialist.

shared_context.S1: The heart-failure clinic has one newly opened evaluation slot tomorrow at 10:00, and referrals for Patient A and Patient B are both being considered.
shared_context.S2: Leah makes the final appointment assignment and records the follow-up plan for the patient who does not receive the slot.
shared_context.S3: Patient B's referral was received two days before Patient A's referral.
shared_context.S4: The clinic's routine process is to hold a brief huddle in which the triage nurse and authorization specialist each provide a relevant update before Leah releases an appointment slot.

PF1.text: Patient A reported two episodes of exertional near-fainting yesterday, and the referring cardiologist instructed that Patient A receive a heart-failure clinician evaluation within 24 hours rather than a routine intake; Mateo documented the telephone triage details in his nursing work queue, but they are not yet in the referral summary.

PF2.text: Patient B's insurer has already approved an in-network video visit with the heart-failure clinic for Thursday at 14:00, and the authorization number is valid for that appointment; Rina received the approval through the payer portal, but it has not yet been attached to the referral.

acceptance_conditions: The next-day 10:00 slot must be assigned to Patient A.
Patient A's visit must be recorded as an urgent heart-failure clinician evaluation rather than a routine intake.
Patient B's alternate follow-up must be recorded for Thursday at 14:00.
Patient B's alternate follow-up must use an in-network video visit.
The approved alternate appointment must be attached to Patient B's referral and communicated to Patient B.
The triage finding must be cited as justification for assigning the next-day slot to Patient A.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'attach_authorization_and_notify' and c['target'] == 'Patient B' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Patient B's earlier referral would otherwise support using the slot for Patient B and a routine visit; the two near-fainting episodes and 24-hour instruction change the patient assignment to Patient A and the visit type to an urgent clinician evaluation.
Without the approved Thursday 14:00 authorization, Patient B has no known alternate appointment, exact time, in-network video format, or authorization-and-notification task to record.
